correctness.rationale: For the 20-vertex cubic triangle-free dodecahedral graph GP(10,2), X=total-three-cut has facets complements of independent triples. Its Alexander dual K consists exactly of subsets with independence number≤2; R(3,3)=6 gives |face|≤5. Complete counts in sizes 0..5 are (1,20,190,480,375,12). Exact signed integer boundary reductions ∂1..∂4 have ranks (19,171,309,12), unit Smith factors and zero remainder, hence reduced integral H3(K)=Z54 only. On 20 vertices combinatorial Alexander duality and UCT yield reduced H14(X)=Z54, others zero. The complete 13-skeleton ensures sufficient connectivity; Hurewicz and homology Whitehead give X≃54 S14 (not mere homology). A separate independently implemented Python check reconstructed all 660 independent triples, K face vector, primitive boundary ranks and all 120 automorphisms and signed Lefschetz character. Traces grouped by order are 1:54×1, 2:6×31, 3:0×20, 5:-1×24, 6:0×20, 10:1×24. Average gives 2 invariant dimensions; central antipode ± eigendim 30/24. Pure dimension16 and H14 nonzero excludes shellability.
